notes: Opens «بهذا الإسناد»: prev1 to prev7 do not write a chain; prev8 (nearest with a written chain) does. How much of prev8's chain this text takes over is not settled by the text, so «بهذا الإسناد» is written as it stands (a back_reference), not expanded into inherited names
«عاصم بن [عن] أبي بصير»: the name is cut off before the bracketed editorial «[عن]»; the surface is written as it stands
The Imam after «عن» stays a narrator, and «قال» introduces his words (the saying)

fixes.reason: The name after «عن» is cut off: «عاصم بن» is followed by a bracketed editorial «[عن]» before «أبي بصير», so the first link's name cannot be read whole.
